words.definition: 强大的；强有力的；有强效的
words.etymology: 来自拉丁语potis “powerful, able, capable; possible”.

words.definition: 影响力；（毒品、药品等的）效力
words.mnemonic: poten（=potent：强大的；有强效的）+ -cy（名词后缀）→影响力

collocations:
impotent, they feel that they have no power to influence people or events.

examples:

potential for violence：暴力倾向

words.definition: 潜在的 n. 潜力；潜质；潜在性
words.mnemonic:
potent（=possible：可能的，潜在的；-ent和-ible均为后缀）+ial（名
词或形容词后缀）→潜在的（adj.）；潜力，潜质（n.）

examples:
